note: Houston County park (leased from USACE) on the Mississippi River south of Brownsville, run by a management contractor. The nightly electric sites are the row west of the beach road and the south loop; the north loop is seasonal. Sandy beach, two boat landings, fishing pier, three shelters. 2-night weekend minimum. Must be 21 to rent a site. --Claude
summary: Read via the Wayback copy of Houston County's parks page (the county site is down) plus the county's 2023 site map, park rules and the Firefly portal: reservable on Firefly through Wildcat Creek Management LLC, water+electric at over 2/3 of sites, showers and dump confirmed; 51 electric + 8 primitive + 35 seasonal sites on the map (county page says 62). Rates, amperage, season and site lengths NOT read: the 2026 fee PDF was never archived and Firefly has no open dates until 2027 loads. Riverfront looks like riverview (nightly pads ~50 m back across the beach road and beach); pin ~260 m off the nightly sites.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> riverview LEAD (stored value is not --AWH). On the county's 2023 map the nightly electric sites are 40-51 (a row at about 43.6858,-91.2733 to 43.6870,-91.2732) and 60-107 (the south loop, about 43.6845,-91.2742). On Esri imagery the 40-51 pads sit about 50 m from the Mississippi with the campground's beach road, a tree row, shelters and the open sand beach between - a park road and a day-use beach block on-water, so a view at best (open across the beach). The south loop (60-107) is behind trees, no water view. Water-edge sites are the north-loop seasonal sites 1-7 (seasonal only, do not earn a value) and primitive sites 120-127 on the beach strip (primitive; not known to be RV-usable). Riverview is the supportable value.

Nightly sites are the majority (51 electric + 8 primitive), and the engine sells Nightly - passes the long-stay tests on what was read.
